description: Complete catalog_anchors() sequence: exact text, label and order.

anchors.label: date
anchors.text: The calendar date or timestamp on which a transaction happened — bill date, invoice date, voucher date, order date, sale date.
anchors.raw_ascii: The calendar date or timestamp on which a transaction happened \u2014 bill date, invoice date, voucher date, order date, sale date.

anchors.label: quantity
anchors.text: How many individual pieces or units were sold on a line — pieces, pcs, stock quantity, units sold, billed quantity.
anchors.raw_ascii: How many individual pieces or units were sold on a line \u2014 pieces, pcs, stock quantity, units sold, billed quantity.

anchors.label: unit_price
anchors.text: The selling price of ONE single piece — the retail rate per unit, not the total for the whole line.
anchors.raw_ascii: The selling price of ONE single piece \u2014 the retail rate per unit, not the total for the whole line.

anchors.label: mrp
anchors.text: The maximum retail price — the printed list price shown to a customer before any discount. This is NOT the price actually charged and NOT the cost price.
anchors.raw_ascii: The maximum retail price \u2014 the printed list price shown to a customer before any discount. This is NOT the price actually charged and NOT the cost price.

anchors.label: cost
anchors.text: What the shop paid for ONE piece — purchase rate, cost price, buying price, wholesale rate, landed cost, COGS.
anchors.raw_ascii: What the shop paid for ONE piece \u2014 purchase rate, cost price, buying price, wholesale rate, landed cost, COGS.

anchors.label: revenue
anchors.text: The total amount for a whole invoice line — quantity multiplied by the unit price, i.e. the line total, net amount or taxable value. This is a LINE TOTAL, not a per-unit price.
anchors.raw_ascii: The total amount for a whole invoice line \u2014 quantity multiplied by the unit price, i.e. the line total, net amount or taxable value. This is a LINE TOTAL, not a per-unit price.

anchors.label: discount
anchors.text: A reduction given off the line — a discount amount, rebate or less-discount value, usually in rupees.
anchors.raw_ascii: A reduction given off the line \u2014 a discount amount, rebate or less-discount value, usually in rupees.

anchors.label: tax
anchors.text: Government tax collected on the line — GST, CGST, SGST, IGST or VAT, reported separately and never counted as profit.
anchors.raw_ascii: Government tax collected on the line \u2014 GST, CGST, SGST, IGST or VAT, reported separately and never counted as profit.

anchors.label: product
anchors.text: The name of the individual product, garment, style or article that was sold — the specific thing, not the group it belongs to.
anchors.raw_ascii: The name of the individual product, garment, style or article that was sold \u2014 the specific thing, not the group it belongs to.

anchors.label: currency
anchors.text: The currency code or symbol for the money amounts on this row — INR, USD, EUR, Rs, etc.
anchors.raw_ascii: The currency code or symbol for the money amounts on this row \u2014 INR, USD, EUR, Rs, etc.

anchors.label: category
anchors.text: The group or department a product belongs to — Kurta, Saree, Shirt, Grocery, Beverages. A classification of the product, not the product itself.
anchors.raw_ascii: The group or department a product belongs to \u2014 Kurta, Saree, Shirt, Grocery, Beverages. A classification of the product, not the product itself.

anchors.label: customer
anchors.text: The person or business the sale was made to — customer name, buyer, party, client. Personal data.
anchors.raw_ascii: The person or business the sale was made to \u2014 customer name, buyer, party, client. Personal data.

anchors.label: region
anchors.text: A geographical or organisational location the sale happened at — branch, store, shop, outlet, godown, warehouse, city.
anchors.raw_ascii: A geographical or organisational location the sale happened at \u2014 branch, store, shop, outlet, godown, warehouse, city.

anchors.label: status
anchors.text: The state of the order or transaction — pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned, paid or unpaid.
anchors.raw_ascii: The state of the order or transaction \u2014 pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned, paid or unpaid.

anchors.label: notes
anchors.text: Free-text remarks written by staff about the transaction — delivery instructions, damage reports, supplier notes, anything typed in a remarks or observation box.
anchors.raw_ascii: Free-text remarks written by staff about the transaction \u2014 delivery instructions, damage reports, supplier notes, anything typed in a remarks or observation box.

anchors.label: id
anchors.text: A unique reference number identifying a transaction or document — invoice number, bill number, voucher number, receipt number or order id.
anchors.raw_ascii: A unique reference number identifying a transaction or document \u2014 invoice number, bill number, voucher number, receipt number or order id.

anchors.label: other
anchors.text: A column that matches none of the known business meanings — an unrecognised extra, a technical artefact, or free text we cannot place.
anchors.raw_ascii: A column that matches none of the known business meanings \u2014 an unrecognised extra, a technical artefact, or free text we cannot place.
